card.name: Linking words before place names
card.fires_on: Commas, 'of', 'or' and semicolons inside lists or comparisons of states, countries and regions, right before the next place name is expected.

modes.label: Comma in list of states
modes.description: A comma after a US state name in a list of states, where another state follows.
modes.example: The ten states that made a difference in the 1916 election were Alabama, California<<,>> Georgia, Kentucky, Missouri, North Caroline

modes.label: Of/or before a region
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'or' in a size or equivalence comparison, just before a region or country name.
modes.example: Celebes, the territorial equal<< of>> all New England; Borneo,

modes.label: Semicolon in region list
modes.description: A semicolon between items in a list of lands or countries.
modes.example: it came to include at the height of its power all of Asia Minor<<;>> the countries of the Balkan Peninsula;

card.writes: It pushes the model toward naming a province, state or region (Chinese provinces, US states, Indian states) next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or comma just before the next state, province or country in a list.
